mechanism.claim: The return direction whose constituent minutes exhibit greater non-Poisson execution-count dispersion is receiving clustered waves of participation rather than merely more aggregate prints. During elevated variation, a new upper-tail directional Fano asymmetry should relay in its native sign for eight hours.
mechanism.side: strict sign of up-minus-down trade-count Fano asymmetry
mechanism.why_distinct: Directional trade breadth compares total counts, trade-arrival backloading compares time buckets, and HVTAMC uses lag-one count autocorrelation. HVTCDAR compares population variance-to-mean ratios conditional on minute return sign and reuses no prior event set or control.
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: offset three-daily onsets from direction-conditioned count overdispersion are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.source_window: 480 exact coherent bars_binance BTCUSDT interval=1m rows [D-8h,D)
features.minute_return: log(close/open); zero-return minutes excluded from directional groups
features.trade_counts: finite nonnegative integer number_of_trades on every minute
features.direction_support: at least 120 positive-return and 120 negative-return minutes
features.fano_up: population variance(number_of_trades on positive-return minutes)/strict-positive mean
features.fano_down: population variance(number_of_trades on negative-return minutes)/strict-positive mean
features.dispersion_asymmetry: (fano_up-fano_down)/(fano_up+fano_down), finite in [-1,1], denominator positive, strict nonzero
features.mean_count_asymmetry_control: mean(up counts)-mean(down counts), strict sign diagnostic only
features.asymmetry_magnitude_rank: strict-prior midrank of abs(asymmetry) over at most 270 earlier source-valid blocks, minimum 180; current excluded; rank>=0.75
features.realized_variation: sum squared minute returns, finite strict positive
features.onset: eligible now and immediately previous exact source-valid block ineligible

clock.decision: D after the full path completes
clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal entry
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact realized funding only after novelty

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp/10bp per notional side, held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source and novelty pass

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no grouping, dispersion, rank, onset, side, clock, hold, subset, threshold, or control repair
